threepl.simulator

Class SimEvent

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimEvent

  • public class SimEvent
extends java.lang.Object
    A SimEvent represents a scheduled event that resides in a SimEventQueue. There are two SimEvent types: an eventCLOCK type represents a clock edge, and an eventSETVAR represents a variable being set to a value. An eventSETVAR is used to set a variable to a value in sync with some other event, like a clock edge. This is needed, for example, when setting and clearing the global_start variable in sync with the clock when a threepl target program starts executing. Each SimEvent stores a "time" for event execution, ie when a clock edge will occur or when a variable will be set. SimEvents are ordered in the SimEventQueue by this time, with the earlier times at the head of the queue. Units for time are tick increments, refer SimClock.
